title: When recursion never stops
summary: What StackOverflowError means and how to fix it.

steps.title: No way out
steps.say: This version forgot to stop at 0, so it keeps calling `factorial(-1)`, `factorial(-2)`... forever.

board.caption: Exception: java.lang.StackOverflowError

steps.title: The fix
steps.say: Every path must reach a base case, and every step must move **toward** it.

steps.title: Strings too
steps.say: `reverseString` shrinks the string each call: the last character, plus the reverse of everything before it, until it's 0 or 1 characters long.
